clauses.text: A person 21 or older who may lawfully possess a handgun may carry it concealed without a permit.
The sheriff shall continue to issue concealed carry permits on request to qualified applicants for use in other states.

current_law: No person may carry a concealed handgun without a concealed carry permit issued by the county sheriff. The sheriff issues permits to applicants 21 or older who may lawfully possess a handgun and complete an eight-hour safety course.
